_doc: Fixed sentinel windows re-rendered by phase4_sentinel_snap.py after every run so model progress is visually comparable across runs. bounds_wgs84 = [W,S,E,N]; alternatively lon/lat/radius_m. Footprint-derived bounds come from photos/*_rgb.tif (static). Edit deliberately: changing a window breaks cross-run comparability for that site.
